WITH per_frequency AS (
  SELECT a.frequency,
         AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                  WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS signed_avg,
         AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
  GROUP BY a.frequency
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(signed_avg) AS mean_signed_avg
  FROM per_frequency
)
SELECT AVG(p.signed_avg) AS average_signed_average,
       AVG(p.balance_avg) AS average_balance_average,
       AVG(p.signed_avg - m.mean_signed_avg) AS average_excess
FROM per_frequency AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE p.signed_avg > m.mean_signed_avg
